title: Length of the list of AND-approximating polynomials
statement: Fix a prime $p$ and, for natural numbers $\mathrm{vars}$, $\mathrm{width}$, and $\ell$, let $P_1,\dots,P_{\mathrm{width}}$ be polynomials in $\mathrm{vars}$ variables over $\bbz/p$. A random seed is a tuple $(S_1,\dots,S_\ell)$ of subsets of the width positions $\{1,\dots,\mathrm{width}\}$, of which there are $(2^{\mathrm{width}})^{\ell} = 2^{\mathrm{width}\cdot\ell}$. The list obtained by recording the AND-approximating polynomial of $P_1,\dots,P_{\mathrm{width}}$ for every such seed therefore has length $2^{\mathrm{width}\cdot\ell}$.
hypotheses_covered: P_1,...,P_width are polynomials in vars variables over Z/p
seeds are l-tuples of subsets of the width positions
list has one entry per seed
